blocks.text: Great news for jobseekers! As the holiday season approaches, JobQuestPH is bringing more career opportunities closer to Filipinos through its District-Wide Hybrid Job Fair 2026, happening on November 24–25 at Level 2, Robinsons Galleria, Ortigas Avenue, followed by a Virtual Job Fair on December 7–9, 2026. Marking JobQuestPH’s final job fair of the year, the event will feature various local and overseas employment opportunities, with on-the-spot interviews and potential immediate hiring during the onsite event.
